{{Navbox/Stats}}
'''{{icon|Speed}}''' affects turn order and movement range.

=== Movement Range ===
{{stat|Movement Range}} is the range in tiles that a unit can move.

Every 2 points of speed away from 5 increases/decreases the units movement range by 1 tile.
* Movement Range cannot go below 1.

The base movement range for cats is 4.<br>
For non cat enemies it is set manually.

The {{st|Slow}} status effect is the most common effect to change a unit's movement range without affecting their Speed, limiting it to just 2 tiles.
<details>
<summary>Other things that affect Movement Range</summary>
* {{st|Movement Up}}
* {{st|Movement Down}}
* {{p|Agile}}: +2
** {{p|Agile|+}}: +4
* {{p|Overflow|+}}: +20, while at full mana.
* {{mut|legs.331}}: +1
* {{d|Paraplegic}}: Limits to a maximum of 1.
* {{i|Feebis}}: Limits to a maximum of 1.
</details>

=== Turn Order ===
Main turn order is determined by ''Iniative'', a hidden stat that is usually equal to {{icon|Speed}} times 2.

Most enemies take their main turn with {{stat|spd|5}}, but some have set base iniatives to always go early, late, or very late.
* Any additional turns enemies have are ''dispersed'' throughout the round and largely ignore Speed calculations.

If 2 units have the same Speed/Iniative, which unit goes first is randomly decided at the start of the battle, with that RNG persisting throughout.

Extra Turns always happen as soon or as late as possible, depending on the source.
